findings.detail: The docstring on line 251 states "RFC 4180-style CSV", but line 254 joins records with `'\n'`. RFC 4180 section 2.1 mandates CRLF as the record separator. No user impact — Excel, LibreOffice and Google Sheets all accept LF-terminated records, and the unit test on `compareRules.test.ts:189` pins the current LF behaviour deliberately. It is only the comment that over-claims, and in a file where every other comment is precise about exactly what it does and does not guarantee, this one sends the next reader to the wrong spec.
findings.summary: toCsv doc says RFC 4180 but emits LF line endings

findings.detail: `settingsKey` serialises `fileColumns` (one `ColDef` object per column per file) on every single render, including renders that cannot change it — `setActiveTab`, `setStatus`, and the per-keystroke re-renders from the column-rename `<input>` on line 677. With 10 files x 100 columns that is a ~100 KB string rebuilt per keystroke while the user is typing a header name. Not a freeze, but it is pure waste in the interaction path the Structure tab is built around, and the handbook's rule 5 covers recreating stable values every render.
findings.summary: settingsKey JSON.stringify runs on every MergeTool render

findings.detail: `lastRunSettings.current` is only assigned AFTER the run completes (line 234), so the clearing effect is unarmed for the whole duration of a run. In `separate` output mode the run genuinely yields at `await zip.generateAsync(...)`, so a user can switch output mode mid-run. Sequence: user changes mode -> effect fires with the new `settingsKey` but bails because `lastRunSettings.current` is still `null` -> the async body then completes and writes `lastRunSettings.current = <old settingsKey>` plus `setSeparateZips(content)` and `setStatus(COMPLETED)`. The effect never re-runs (its dep `settingsKey` has not changed since), so the result produced under the old settings survives the change the guard exists to catch. Concretely: `downloadResult()` then takes neither branch (`outputMode` is no longer `'separate'`, `mergedData` is `null`), so the visible "Download Output File" button does nothing. Narrow trigger and no wrong data is written, hence low; it would be medium if the single/sheets paths also yielded, since then the stale result would actually download under the new settings.
findings.summary: Stale-result guard misses settings changed during async processing
